conversations.transcript_method: Human-authored YouTube English captions (json3) fetched with yt-dlp --skip-download; NOT transcribed by Natively (no audio downloaded: disk had <500MB free). Transcription is not part of this benchmark.
conversations.preprocessing: ALL-CAPS broadcast captions sentence-cased (small acronym list kept upper; proper nouns lowercased); caption events merged/split at sentence boundaries (<=45 words) to approximate STT finalization; all lines on system-audio speaker_1 (no diarization in captions); real caption timing used for timestamps
